entries.text: You see the Master of the Super Mutants.
entries.source_text: You see the Master of the Super Mutants.

entries.text: So, what shall it be?  Do you join the Unity or do you die here? Join! Die! Join! Die!
entries.source_text:
So, what shall it be?  Do you join the Unity or do you die here?
 Join! Die! Join! Die!

entries.text: I can't win.  I'll join you.
entries.source_text: I can't win.  I'll join you.

entries.text: If you can prove to me that your Unity is the best course for humanity, then I will help you.
entries.source_text:
If you can prove to me that your Unity is the best course for humanity,
 then I will help you.

entries.text: How about you die, then I leave?
entries.source_text: How about you die, then I leave?

entries.text: Oh, there will be death today, but not mine.  I've got a plan.
entries.source_text: Oh, there will be death today, but not mine.  I've got a plan.

entries.text: Ugh. Lee.
entries.source_text: Ugh. Lee.

entries.text: Excellent. Your talents will be useful. But first, you must tell me everything about your Vault.
entries.source_text:
Excellent. Your talents will be useful. But first, you must tell me
 everything about your Vault.

entries.text: Why?
entries.source_text: Why?

entries.text: OK.  I'll tell you everything you want to know.
entries.source_text: OK.  I'll tell you everything you want to know.

entries.text: I will conquer it and turn all those pure strain humans into mutants. They will give me the army I need to bring peace to the entire wasteland.
entries.source_text:
I will conquer it and turn all those pure strain humans into mutants.
 They will give me the army I need to bring peace to the entire wasteland.

entries.text: Sorry, I don't like that plan much.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I don't like that plan much.

entries.text: Sounds reasonable. Let's do it.
entries.source_text: Sounds reasonable. Let's do it.

entries.text: So be it. You've dug your own grave. Grave! Grave!
entries.source_text: So be it. You've dug your own grave. Grave! Grave!

entries.text: I don't have to prove anything to you! Prove.
entries.source_text: I don't have to prove anything to you! Prove.

entries.text: Your ego demands you tell me. All villains have this strange urge to explain everything.
entries.source_text:
Your ego demands you tell me. All villains have this strange
 urge to explain everything.

entries.text: I can't know you represent the best future, unless you prove it to me.
entries.source_text: I can't know you represent the best future, unless you prove it to me.

entries.text: Very demanding for one in your tenuous position. But I can respect your needs.
entries.source_text:
Very demanding for one in your tenuous position. But I can respect
 your needs.

entries.text: So tell me.
entries.source_text: So tell me.

entries.text: The Unity will bring about the master race. Master! Master! One able to survive, or even thrive, in the wasteland. As long as there are differences, we will tear ourselves apart fighting each other. We need one race. Race! Race! One goal. Goal! Goal! One people . . . to move forward to our destiny. Destiny.
entries.source_text:
The Unity will bring about the master race. Master! Master!
 One able to survive, or even thrive, in the wasteland. As long as there are
 differences, we will tear ourselves apart fighting each other. We
 need one race. Race! Race! One goal. Goal! Goal! One people . . . to
 move forward to our destiny. Destiny.

entries.text: That race being the mutants, of course.
entries.source_text: That race being the mutants, of course.

entries.text: I hope we won't end up looking like you.
entries.source_text: I hope we won't end up looking like you.

entries.text: Of course. Mutants are best equipped to deal with the world today. Who else? The ghouls. Please. Normals. They brought nuclear death to us all. This will be the age of mutants. Mutants.
entries.source_text:
Of course. Mutants are best equipped to deal with the world today.
 Who else? The ghouls. Please. Normals. They brought nuclear
 death to us all. This will be the age of mutants. Mutants.

entries.text: You mean to change all the others into mutants, as well.
entries.source_text: You mean to change all the others into mutants, as well.

entries.text: You're such a bigot.
entries.source_text: You're such a bigot.

entries.text: What about those who oppose you?
entries.source_text: What about those who oppose you?

entries.text: All that resist, yes. All those that are required for the Unity as well. The remainder will be allowed to live out their days, but under Unity control and protection. But none shall breed, for they will be the last of their race.
entries.source_text:
All that resist, yes. All those that are required for the
 Unity as well. The remainder will be allowed to live out their days,
 but under Unity control and protection. But none shall breed, for they
 will be the last of their race.

entries.text: You've got a problem with your master plan.
entries.source_text: You've got a problem with your master plan.

entries.text: Sounds like you've got it under control.  I'll join up.
entries.source_text: Sounds like you've got it under control.  I'll join up.

entries.text: I think you are, all of you are, nuts and I need to stop you now.
entries.source_text: I think you are, all of you are, nuts and I need to stop you now.

entries.text: And what is that?
entries.source_text: And what is that?

entries.text: You didn't take into account me! I'm stopping you right here, right now!
entries.source_text: You didn't take into account me! I'm stopping you right here, right now!

entries.text: You can't possibly take on the entire world.
entries.source_text: You can't possibly take on the entire world.

entries.text: I happen to know that your mutants are sterile.
entries.source_text: I happen to know that your mutants are sterile.

entries.text: I'm not after the world, yet. When I turn your fellow vault-dwellers into mutants, my forces will be too strong for any to stand against! But don't worry, you won't care. Care! Care!
entries.source_text:
I'm not after the world, yet. When I turn your fellow vault-dwellers
 into mutants, my forces will be too strong for any to stand against!
 But don't worry, you won't care. Care! Care!

entries.text: Preposterous! The FEV-2 virus doesn't destroy the reproductive organs of those it mutates.
entries.source_text:
Preposterous! The FEV-2 virus doesn't destroy the reproductive organs
 of those it mutates.

entries.text: Perhaps the virus didn't sterilize people once, but it does now.
entries.source_text: Perhaps the virus didn't sterilize people once, but it does now.

entries.text: Have you talked to any of your mutants about this?
entries.source_text: Have you talked to any of your mutants about this?

entries.text: Maybe it's all that extra radiation.
entries.source_text: Maybe it's all that extra radiation.

entries.text: Do you have proof?
entries.source_text: Do you have proof?

entries.text: Of course, I do! Here it is . . .
entries.source_text: Of course, I do! Here it is . . .

entries.text: Take my word for it, it happens.
entries.source_text: Take my word for it, it happens.

entries.text: Ask your own mutants.
entries.source_text: Ask your own mutants.

entries.text: This proves nothing! You will pay for your insolence. Pay!
entries.source_text: This proves nothing! You will pay for your insolence. Pay!

entries.text: I must digest this information. One moment.
entries.source_text: I must digest this information. One moment.

entries.text: I must digest this information. One moment . . . I understand now. You made a clever forgery. You made this up to fool me. Fool! Me!
entries.source_text:
I must digest this information. One moment . . . I understand now.
 You made a clever forgery. You made this up to fool me. Fool! Me!

entries.text: What!? I don't understand, I thought it was correct!
entries.source_text: What!? I don't understand, I thought it was correct!

entries.text: You're lying! You're denying the facts in front of you!
entries.source_text: You're lying! You're denying the facts in front of you!

entries.text: You will pay for what you have done! Pay! Done.
entries.source_text: You will pay for what you have done! Pay! Done.

entries.text: But it cannot be. This would mean that all my work has been for nothing. Everything that I have tried to . . . a failure!  It can't be. Be. Be. Be.
entries.source_text:
But it cannot be. This would mean that all my work has been for
 nothing. Everything that I have tried to . . . a failure!  It can't be.
 Be. Be. Be.

entries.text: Sorry, this isn't an option for you. Your race will die out after this generation.
entries.source_text:
Sorry, this isn't an option for you. Your race will die out
 after this generation.

entries.text: Maybe there is something that can be done. Perhaps you need more test subjects.
entries.source_text:
Maybe there is something that can be done. Perhaps you need more
 test subjects.

entries.text: Yes. More subjects. I think I shall start with you. Do! Do!
entries.source_text: Yes. More subjects. I think I shall start with you. Do! Do!

entries.text: I . . . don't think that I can continue. Continue? To have done the things I have done in the name of progress and healing. It was madness. I can see that now. Madness. Madness? There is no hope. Leave now, leave while you still have hope . . .
entries.source_text:
I . . . don't think that I can continue. Continue? To have done the
 things I have done in the name of progress and healing. It was
 madness. I can see that now. Madness. Madness? There is no hope.
 Leave now, leave while you still have hope . . .

entries.text: I believe I shall. Don't move.
entries.source_text: I believe I shall. Don't move.

entries.text: My scientists assure me that nothing is wrong. What do you say to that? Say! Say!
entries.source_text:
My scientists assure me that nothing is wrong.
 What do you say to that? Say! Say!

entries.text: Did you think to ask a female mutant?
entries.source_text: Did you think to ask a female mutant?

entries.text: Ask one of your Lieutenants.
entries.source_text: Ask one of your Lieutenants.

entries.text: They're afraid of you. You think they'll tell you the truth?
entries.source_text: They're afraid of you. You think they'll tell you the truth?

entries.text: One moment. He cannot be reached. He must be dead and I can guess who killed him. Killed! Kill!
entries.source_text:
One moment. He cannot be reached. He must be dead and I can
 guess who killed him. Killed! Kill!

entries.text: He denies everything. And he says he knows who started this rumor . . .
entries.source_text:
He denies everything. And he says he knows who started
 this rumor . . .

entries.text: I think I know who the liar is. Liar!
entries.source_text: I think I know who the liar is. Liar!

entries.text: Reasonable. One moment. Are you sure? What about the other females? It cannot be. Be.
entries.source_text:
Reasonable. One moment. Are you sure? What about the other females?
 It cannot be. Be.

entries.text: Sorry, your race is doomed.
entries.source_text: Sorry, your race is doomed.

entries.text: Excuse me while I gloat . . . Told ya so!
entries.source_text: Excuse me while I gloat . . . Told ya so!

entries.text: Without any proof, I'm afraid I can't believe you. Now, you will join my army as a mutant or you will die! Die! Join!
entries.source_text:
Without any proof, I'm afraid I can't believe you. Now, you will join
 my army as a mutant or you will die! Die! Join!

entries.text: Better dead than like you.
entries.source_text: Better dead than like you.

entries.text: It means giving up everything I know, but I'll join.
entries.source_text: It means giving up everything I know, but I'll join.

entries.text: Your humor will not save you now. Do you accept my offer, or not? Not! Accept!
entries.source_text:
Your humor will not save you now. Do you accept my offer, or not? Not!
 Accept!

entries.text: Not.
entries.source_text: Not.

entries.text: OK, it's better than dying . . .
entries.source_text: OK, it's better than dying . . .

entries.text: Radiation has no effect on us. The FEV virus makes us immune. Your argument is weak, and so are you.
entries.source_text:
Radiation has no effect on us. The FEV virus makes us immune.
 Your argument is weak, and so are you.

entries.text: Oh, I think you are wrong. But just to be sure, I will order this matter researched. After I have taken care of you. Care. Care!
entries.source_text:
Oh, I think you are wrong. But just to be sure, I will order
 this matter researched. After I have taken care of you. Care. Care!

entries.text: My only problem is you. Now, will you work for the Unity, or not?
entries.source_text: My only problem is you. Now, will you work for the Unity, or not?

entries.text: Not.
entries.source_text: Not.

entries.text: Sure.
entries.source_text: Sure.

entries.text: They will be punished for their insolence.
entries.source_text: They will be punished for their insolence.

entries.text: You mean to kill them all?
entries.source_text: You mean to kill them all?

entries.text: Then I must stop you now!
entries.source_text: Then I must stop you now!

entries.text: Of course not. Most will be offered a chance to become a mutant. Those who deny this opportunity will be sterilized and let go. Those that resist will be executed.
entries.source_text:
Of course not. Most will be offered a chance to become
 a mutant. Those who deny this opportunity will be sterilized and let go.
 Those that resist will be executed.

entries.text: You are one sick puppy. Time to put you down.
entries.source_text: You are one sick puppy. Time to put you down.

entries.text: Hmm, I'm not big on being executed . . . I'm joining.
entries.source_text: Hmm, I'm not big on being executed . . . I'm joining.

entries.text: We are all biased, are we not?  We each care more about our individual communities than other people. We haven't changed, and I'll tell you something else . . .
entries.source_text:
We are all biased, are we not?  We each care more about
 our individual communities than other people. We haven't changed, and
 I'll tell you something else . . .

entries.text: What's that?
entries.source_text: What's that?

entries.text: We won't change. Not unless we are of one people. One. One. One. One race. One. One. One. The Unity will allow us to move beyond these petty concerns and deal with the major problems at hand.  You want to be a part of that, don't you? Part. Don't.

 race. One. One. One. The Unity will allow us to move beyond these

entries.text: You've convinced me. I'll join the Unity.
entries.source_text: You've convinced me. I'll join the Unity.

entries.text: I want a part of you . . . your head!
entries.source_text: I want a part of you . . . your head!

entries.text: Of course! The mutants will survive! The mutants will rebuild this world! And only as a mutant, will you be allowed to live! Live. Die!
entries.source_text:
Of course! The mutants will survive! The mutants will rebuild this

entries.text: Live!
entries.source_text: Live!

entries.text: Die!
entries.source_text: Die!

entries.text: All you care about is your mutants and their Unity.
entries.source_text: All you care about is your mutants and their Unity.

entries.text: I am no villain. You have no idea what I, or the Unity is about.
entries.source_text: I am no villain. You have no idea what I, or the Unity is about.

entries.text: Then tell me what you are about.
entries.source_text: Then tell me what you are about.

entries.text: You are a villain. You're just denying your inner feelings.
entries.source_text: You are a villain. You're just denying your inner feelings.

entries.text: I don't have to prove myself to you. Using your logic, that must, prove I am not a villain. It would be a hopeless cause to explain it to you.

entries.text: Oh? Please, what sort of plan might that be?
entries.source_text: Oh? Please, what sort of plan might that be?

entries.text: I'm going to set off a nuclear device in this Vault. It will explode shortly, taking you all to hell!
entries.source_text:
I'm going to set off a nuclear device in this Vault. It will explode

entries.text: I'll kill you and that'll make it difficult for you to continue, right?

entries.text: I convinced the Brotherhood of Steel to invade this place if I was captured and not set free.  They will be here any moment.

entries.text: You are lying. It will be the last lie that you tell.

entries.text: One moment while I check out your story. You might be telling the truth. Guards! Take this human to the reactor core. Deal with the problem before it's too late.
